# This website — Mobile Phone Prices & Specifications

> This website is a mobile phone comparison platform, providing up-to-date prices, detailed technical specifications, retailer comparisons, and user reviews across all major mobile brands.

## Main Navigation

- [Phone Catalog](https://mobilerates.info/phones): Search, filter, and browse all mobile phones by brand, price, RAM, camera, and battery.
- [Mobile Brands](https://mobilerates.info/brands): View all smartphone manufacturers and their complete phone lineups.
- [Phone Comparison](https://mobilerates.info/compare): Compare two or more smartphones side-by-side on price, specs, display, processor, camera, and battery.
- [Tech News & Reviews](https://mobilerates.info/news): Read latest mobile phone news, reviews, launch updates, and buying guides.
- [HTML Sitemap](https://mobilerates.info/site-map): Complete index of all static and dynamic pages on This website.

## Mobiles by Budget Range

- [Mobiles under Rs. 15,000](https://mobilerates.info/phones?max_price=15000): Budget entry-level smartphones.
- [Mobiles under Rs. 30,000](https://mobilerates.info/phones?max_price=30000): Affordable mid-range devices.
- [Mobiles under Rs. 50,000](https://mobilerates.info/phones?max_price=50000): Value-for-money feature-packed phones.
- [Mobiles under Rs. 80,000](https://mobilerates.info/phones?max_price=80000): Premium mid-range and upper tier smartphones.
- [Mobiles under Rs. 150,000](https://mobilerates.info/phones?max_price=150000): Flagship and high-performance smartphones.
